---
title: Installation
output:
  pkgdown:
    toc: FALSE
---

`MuSiC` is implemented as an
R package, `r BiocStyle::Githubpkg('xuranw', 'MuSiC')`, which can be
installed from GitHub by:
  
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install pak if necessary
install.packages("pak")

# install bseqsc
pak::pak("xuranw/MuSiC")

# load
library(MuSiC)
```
